title: Product-Agent OS Track 11 G5 evidence quality and final site gate docs packet

Root site/search/sitemap freshness remains deferred to DOC-M25 and was not run in this slice.

DOC-M28.acceptance_summary: Graph ontology, coverage, freshness, rejected links, bounded query packets and source-read-before-edit rules are documented.

DOC-M30.acceptance_summary: Real-target static comparison redaction, residual G1.1 follow-up routing and row-level G2-G5 closure status are documented.

DOC-M25.acceptance_summary: Final root site rebuild remains a separate approval gate after G2-G5 source updates; this packet does not claim generated site freshness.
